title: Baby Bouncers playtime
description: Bouncy songs, rhymes and playtime for crawlers and babies taking their first steps. Two sessions, 10:15 and 11:15.
imagePrompt: Grown-ups bouncing smiling babies (6–15 months) on their knees during a song circle on a soft carpet in a library children's room. Colorful scarves and soft toys on the floor. Diverse families, bright and joyful.

title: Preschool storytime + craft
description: Stories, songs, rhymes and a themed craft for ages 3–6.
registration: Pick up a free ticket at the children's desk.
imagePrompt: A friendly children's librarian sits on a low chair reading a colorful picture book to a small circle of preschoolers (ages 3–6) sitting cross-legged on a carpet in a bright public library children's area. Low bookshelves, kids' craft table with paper and glue sticks in the background. Diverse kids, natural soft daylight, cheerful and calm.

title: Tiny Tykes storytime
description: Interactive storytime for new walkers and their grown-ups: stories, songs and finger plays. Two sessions, 10:15 and 11:15. Some weeks it's outside in the Reading Garden.
imagePrompt: Parents sitting on a library carpet with new walkers (about 12–24 months) on their laps, doing finger plays and singing along with a librarian holding a big picture book. Soft daylight, cozy children's library corner. Diverse families.

title: Toddler storytime
description: Books, songs and movement for ages 18–36 months with a caregiver.
registration: Free. Registration opens about two weeks ahead on the library calendar.
imagePrompt: Toddlers (18–36 months) and their caregivers doing a movement song with arms up during storytime in a modern, bright library with big windows. A librarian leads from the front with a picture book. Diverse families.

title: Stories & Crafts in the Cabin
description: A nature story and craft in the sanctuary's log cabin for ages 3–5 with an adult. Siblings with a supervising adult come free.
imagePrompt: Inside a rustic log cabin in the woods, preschoolers (ages 3–5) with their parents make leaf and pinecone crafts at a wooden table while a nature educator holds a picture book about animals. Sunlight through the windows, tall trees outside.

title: Tyke Hike at Arrowwood Pond
description: A guided nature walk for ages 18 months to 4 years with a grown-up: bugs, leaves, pond critters and lots of stopping to look.
registration: No sign-up needed, but it's capped at 20 kids. Check in at the Beautyberry Classroom.
imagePrompt: Toddlers and preschoolers in sneakers crouch at the edge of a small woodland pond with their grown-ups, pointing at a turtle and dragonflies, a guide with a magnifying glass beside them. Shady forest trail, dappled light.

title: Grownup & me classes at The Bunny Hive
description: 30-minute classes for little ones and their grownups in a cozy Heights bungalow: sensory play, ballet, culinary exploration, storytime and baby massage. Times change week to week.
registration: Book on The Bunny Hive's site. A two-week intro offer is available.
imagePrompt: A cozy, sunny bungalow playroom with soft neutral decor where toddlers and their grown-ups do a sensory play class: bins of colorful rice, scarves and wooden toys on a rug. Calm, happy, Pinterest-style aesthetic.
